name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 4 visits over 38 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 16 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 38 hours starting 2026-06-15, at wavelengths from 0.84 to 3.36 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
